page_title: ALM 0-2 BAR | Almeria v Barcelona 16/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Javier Alberola Rojas is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Joao Felix (Barcelona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) tested Luis Maximiano with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
87' Joao Felix (Barcelona) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
87' Almeria concede a free kick following a bad challenge. A free kick to Barcelona.
85' A yellow card for a tackle by Vitor Roque (Barcelona). Javier Alberola Rojas doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
84' Cesar Montes (Almeria) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
83' Cesar Montes (Almeria) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) is coming onto the pitch as Pedri cannot continue after picking up an injury.
80' Pepe Mel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) replacing Marc Pubill.
80' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Adrian Embarba as he is replaced by Alejandro Centelles Plaza (Almeria).
80' Joao Felix (Barcelona) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
79' An attempted cross from Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) is cleared.
79' Javier Alberola Rojas interrupts the game. One of the players from Barcelona won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Almeria.

78' Barcelona are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
75' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Joao Felix (Barcelona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
74' Here is a change. Hector Fort is going off and Xavi gives the last tactical orders to Joao Cancelo (Barcelona).
73' Substitution. Ferran Torres leaves the pitch and is replaced by Vitor Roque (Barcelona).
73' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul after Hector Fort (Barcelona) hacks down one of his opponents. Almeria have a free kick.
69' Xavi has decided to substitute Robert Lewandowski and he is replaced by Joao Felix (Barcelona).
69' It's time for a substitution. Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) comes on in place of Sergi Roberto.
68' The referee signals a substitution. Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) is brought on as a substitute for Jonathan Viera.

68' 0 - 2 Goal! Sergi Roberto displays great vision and sends a pass to Fermin Lopez (Barcelona), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 0:2.
66' Almeria quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
65' A pass into the penalty area from Luis Suarez (Almeria) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Almeria are awarded a corner kick.

64' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Javier Alberola Rojas has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Free kick. Barcelona will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
63' One of the Barcelona players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. A free kick is awarded to Almeria.
62' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
61' Luis Suarez (Almeria) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Barcelona will take a free kick near the side line.
60' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
59' Pepe Mel decides to make a substitution. Choco Lozano will be replaced by Luis Suarez (Almeria).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leo Baptistao departs the field of play to be replaced by Luka Romero (Almeria).
58' Cesar Montes (Almeria) jumps into a tackle and Javier Alberola Rojas signals a foul. Barcelona earn a free kick.
57' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) is caught offside!

56' A long pass finds Lucas Robertone (Almeria) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
51' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Luis Maximiano makes a save.
50' The attendance for today's match is 15543.
50' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ferran Torres (Barcelona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
49' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Barcelona have a corner.

47' Choco Lozano (Almeria) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
46' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle and it's Choco Lozano (Almeria) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Barcelona have a free kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

45+2' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the left side of the goal. Luis Maximiano is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Barcelona force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Choco Lozano (Almeria) heads on.
43' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
42' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!
41' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Almeria comes to nothing.
40' Marc Pubill (Almeria) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
38' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Almeria, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
38' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Almeria get a free kick.
38' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Almeria.
35' A player from Almeria commits a rough challenge. Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Barcelona are awarded the free kick.
32' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
31' Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Almeria.
28' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
28' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
28' Almeria quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
28' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Almeria.
28' The corner is swung in but Almeria can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Almeria.
25' Choco Lozano (Almeria) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Marc-Andre ter Stegen stops the ball from going inside right post.
24' Hector Fort (Barcelona) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.

22' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
20' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
20' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
19' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
18' Hector Fort (Barcelona) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
14' 0 - 1 Goal! Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Hector Fort and easily beat the keeper with a header into the top right corner from close range. 0:1.
13' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
11' Bruno Langa (Almeria) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!

11' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Alberola Rojas with no other option than to blow for a foul. Almeria are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
10' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
8' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
7' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
7' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
4' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Almeria was in an offside position.
3' A snap shot by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Luis Maximiano produces a good save to thwart him.
2' Cesar Montes (Almeria) makes a slide tackle, but referee Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul.
1' The linesman raises his flag. Jonathan Viera (Almeria) is adjudged offside.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Barcelona will have the kick-off.
Javier Alberola Rojas got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
